summary: No external source was integrated. None could be verified in this environment (no supplied data; no general internet access). Nothing was fabricated.
protocol: historical availability over the full 2020-11..2026-11 span
timestamp + timezone reliability (DST handling, release-time vs bar-close)
availability at actual inference time (latency, API access, licence)
incremental value: train-fit HistGradientBoosting ablation, validation-confirmed (see feature_report.py)

economic_calendar_actuals.purpose: event risk windows (NFP, CPI, FOMC) and surprise = actual - forecast
needs: event timestamp in UTC with documented timezone
actual AND consensus forecast AND first-release (not revised) values
intraday history aligned to broker server clock (timezone offset documented)
licence; note DXY is itself ~58% EURUSD (check redundancy with FX data)
intraday or at least daily point-in-time series (FRED daily is end-of-day: only usable lagged)
same-broker XAGUSD candles preferred (same clock, same costs, available at inference through MT5)
measure incremental value vs XAUUSD own features

tick_volume_existing.purpose: already in the data (tick_volume); evaluated in the feature report
tick_volume_existing.notes: broker tick count, NOT centralized exchange volume; real_volume is all zero

how_to_add: Provide a CSV (time, value columns) and run stage5.source_quality.evaluate_source(df, tz_note=..., max_lag_minutes=...); then add features through the existing feature pipeline and rerun feature_report.py (train selection, validation confirmation).
news_tasks: News/event-based tasks are excluded: no verified historical event data exists in the project; models must not invent news.
